captions.text: Pairagraph — a simple place to read, practice, and try again.
Before reading, review the microphone prompt and give permission.
Tick the consent box, then choose Record.
The story appears when recording starts. Read aloud at your own pace.
Make the text larger when needed. Stop stays at the bottom center.
After Stop: choose peach Record again, or green See how I did.
A spinning circle shows that your results are loading.
Friendly feedback suggests a few practice words. The AI can mishear.
Open Look at my reading to compare the story with what was heard.
One clear next step: Read this story. Or take a break.
My progress keeps saved readings and suggested words together.
